universe: JRA flat, field_size>=12, 3-win class or higher; exact M3 validation universe

protocol.note: Candidate selection was informed by 2025-2026 diagnostic results. These are exploratory diagnostics, not pristine future-holdout validation and therefore are not eligible for automatic probability correction.

previous_escape_bad.definition: Previous strictly-prior start: first available corner position=1 and finish>=4

previous_slow_escape.definition: Previous strictly-prior start: first available corner position=1 and RPCI>=55

previous_front_hold_good.definition: Previous strictly-prior start: normalized first-corner frontness>=0.70, fourth-corner position no worse than first-corner position+1, finish<=3
previous_front_hold_good.reason: Despite two-year diagnostic improvement, the feature was selected after inspecting 2025-2026 outcomes, so it must remain descriptive until future prospective validation.

previous_generic_pace_fit_good.definition: Good previous finish with coarse pace-style match
previous_generic_pace_fit_good.reason: Direction was not stable from 2024 development to 2025-2026 diagnostics.

previous_inner_forward_good.definition: Inner-third gate plus forward position plus top-3 previous finish
previous_inner_forward_good.reason: Diagnostics did not support treating the proxy as a next-run negative factor.

ui_policy: Show reproducibility warnings/positive monitoring tags only. Do not change M3 rank or structural top-3 probability from these exploratory signals until a new prospective holdout confirms them.
